title: GARF: Group-Aware Random Forest matching for panel counterfactuals (Stata command and Python engine)
description: GARF builds comparison groups for policy evaluation with panel data. Each unit's pre-treatment history is encoded as levels and trajectory descriptors, a random forest is trained on treatment, and treated units are matched to untreated donors on the forest's leaf proximity. The package contains the Python engine, the Stata command garf, a user guide and do-files for the design-stage diagnostics. It returns a matched panel and pre-treatment diagnostics.
